last.verdict: Strong beat and raised outlook, but a soft Q4 and weak cash flow disappointed.

reasons.label: Soft fourth quarter
reasons.text: New full-year outlook implies Q4 profit of about $1.87-$1.97 per share, below the roughly $2.04 expected.

reasons.label: Weaker cash flow
reasons.text: Free cash flow fell 14% to $2.0 billion in the quarter.

reasons.label: 2027 cost warning
reasons.text: Ramping up GE9X engines for Boeing's delayed 777X is expected to cut 2027 profit by about $300 million.

story: GE Aerospace has beaten estimates and raised its yearly outlook at each recent report. The stock has still slipped after the last few, including about 5% after July's report. A high price (about 46x expected earnings) leaves little room for anything short of perfect.
